manifest.target: fasthttp HTTP/1.1; validates 1 KiB POST body; 1 KiB response; no delay
manifest.verdict_rule: held = target-validated requests per second over the measured window >= requested * (1 - tolerance), with zero invalid requests in the window
manifest.cpu_rule: generator_cpu_us_per_request = change in the generator cgroup cpu.stat usage_usec over the measured window / target-validated requests in the window

reasons: planned requests were missed or interrupted; inspect busy, late and canceled counts
